messages:
Kai: Quick heads-up — onboarding mixtral-7b-v2 hit a weird perf cliff on long contexts (>2048). Profiling attached, looks like an unexpected kernel fallback + large KV evictions.
Chandra: :eyes: can you paste the profiler lines?
Kai: Sure — here's the relevant tail from the run:
```
selected_kernel: matmul_attention_dispatcher_v2
fallback_kernel: matmul_fallback_generic
latency_tokens: {1024: 18ms, 2048: 22ms, 3072: 48ms}  # jump at 3072
kv_cache_evictions: 512
mem_pressure_event: true
```
Ben: That latency jump + fallback_kernel is suspicious. Do we have HF config parsed correctly? Last time a bad `num_heads` in metadata caused head-shape mismatch and forced different kernels.
Amanda: Looking at the safetensors blob for this model — metadata is missing the `axes` entry and `num_attention_heads` is absent. Converter fell back to best-effort and guessed head_dim=64, but weights shape implies 40 heads.
Chandra: So the runtime sees mismatched head/kv dims and chooses a safer (slower) kernel path + does extra KV bookkeeping -> eviction spikes. Makes sense.
Kai: Reproduced locally with the same converted weights. Repro steps:
```bash
# quick reproduce (dev env)
PYTHONPATH=. pytest tests/onboarding/test_mixtral_perf.py::test_long_context -k 3072 -q
# or run the minimal runner
python tools/run_inference.py --model models/mixtral-7b-v2 --seq-len 3072 --profile
```
Ben: I pushed a quick probe to triage the HF parse behavior: PR #4682 (parser: infer missing num_heads from weight shapes and warn loudly). If axes missing -> try {"batch, seq, heads, head_dim"} heuristics and emit a conversion warning.
Amanda: Also pushed a conversion helper: `scripts/fix_safetensors_axes.py` that inserts proper axes and recomputes head split. Usage: `python scripts/fix_safetensors_axes.py --in raw.safetensors --out fixed.safetensors --num_heads 40`
Chandra: For immediate mitigation in runtime, we can add a small heuristic: prefer fused_causal_attention_v1 when head/kv dims disagree but weights are large, instead of falling back to totally generic matmul. That keeps per-token latency stable. Kai — can you try pinning kernel via model override?
Kai: Done: set `runtime_override.kernel_pref = ["fused_causal_attention_v1"]` and reran. Latency curve flattened: 3072 -> 24ms instead of 48ms. Not a perfect fix but acceptable for onboarding.
Ben: Note: pinning hides the underlying mismatch. We should still fix converter + parser. I also saw the KV-eviction count grow linearly with sequence length when head_dim mismatch occurs — that suggests our KV layout assumptions differ and evictions are being triggered incorrectly. I'll add a unit test to assert kv.size == expected_heads * head_dim.
Amanda: File-level note: many upstream safetensors omit metadata fields. Our converter needs to be defensive. PR #4683 will add a strict-mode flag and an "infer-if-missing" mode.
runtime-bot: profiling-report uploaded: https://storage.redwood/profiles/2419999999/mixtral-v2-profile.html
Chandra: Another angle — batching heuristics. When the batcher scores requests it currently ignores an eviction penalty. If a request would cause >X evictions, it should get a higher cost and be deprioritized, which prevents hot requests from forcing kernel fallback for the whole pool. I'll open an RFC for the batcher scoring tweak.
Ben: Agree. Quick patch suggestion for batcher score: score += eviction_count * eviction_penalty_factor (default 0.3). We can tune. Might reduce throughput but reduce tail latency spikes.
Kai: Owners and actions: 
- Ben: land parser inference + tests (PR #4682).
- Amanda: land converter helper + strict/infer modes (PR #4683).
- Chandra: RFC for batcher eviction-aware scoring (will post today).
- Kai: temporary kernel pin in model config for affected tenants + follow-up with infra to re-run onboarding tests.
Amanda: I'll also run a sweep to check other recently onboarded models for missing axes (search by missing metadata tag). Expect a handful.
Ben: One more gotcha — safetensors with transposed qkv ordering (q,k,v packed) can also make the parser infer wrong heads. Our converter now checks for canonical ordering and swaps if necessary.
Kai: Thanks team. If anyone hits a similar regression, call out the profiler lines I pasted and try kernel pin before a full rollback. I'll post the final verification runs in ~2h. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deployed temp kernel-override to sandbox for mixtral-7b-v2 (deploy id: dpl-7891).
Chandra: :shipit: closing triage once PRs land and onboarding tests pass.
